system.description:
Some Druids have walked close enough to the boundary between divine and arcane magic to understand both. They don't cross it — but they stand near the edge and look over.

  • Verdant Power: When you cast a damage-dealing spell, add your Wisdom modifier as bonus damage to one target.
  • Deep Roots: Advantage on all checks to identify, counter, or dispel magical effects in natural environments. Spells you cast in natural terrain cannot be counterspelled by casters of lower level than you.
